title: Dual-sphere exchange media
scope: Qualitative dual-sphere exchange pattern for the ridge-spur settlement and the outlet settlement: an external prestige sphere of surviving imperial coin above an internal customary sphere of obligation, labour-exchange, tally credit, and in-kind return, with socially marked conversion; usable for economic, political, and story texture without establishing prices, denominations, rates, quantities, metals, names, scripts, mints, treasuries, markets, harvest-trade practice, compact finance, occurred trade events, or any System recognition of value.
claims: Two customary spheres of worth exist, one riding above the other: an external or prestige sphere running on surviving imperial coin — inter-settlement trade, storage of worth, prestige transfers, and, where a consented communal burden is discharged in movable worth at all, the customary medium of that discharge — and an internal or customary sphere running on obligation: witnessed debts, labour-exchange, tally customs, and in-kind return inside each settlement.

Imperial coinage existed and physical imperial coins survive in the region; coin circulates in qualitative worth classes sourced from pre-drawdown household holdings, salvage finds, and cross-lake inflow, with no denomination, legend, metal, design, or quantity established.

No functioning imperial mint or treasury authority survives anywhere in the region and no local authority currently mints or validates coin; wear, clipping, and household hoarding are live qualitative attrition concerns and the trusted stock is thinning.

Internal-sphere credit runs on qualitative customs — witnessed debts, obligation held in memory and in tally media, labour-exchange, and in-kind return — with no ledger institution, unit, record form, office, or enforcement mechanism established.

Converting between spheres is socially marked: paying a neighbour in coin reads as distancing or as ceremony, and turning standing obligation into coin, or coin into standing, is noticed, storied, and sometimes resented; this is qualitative social meaning only, with no rule, prohibition, or conversion rate, and the marking itself varies by household and situation.

Exchange between the ridge-spur settlement and the outlet settlement is real and ongoing exactly as WLD-EVENT-001's standing rivalry already presupposes; no trade event, negotiation, or incident is established.

WLD-EVENT-001's contested-exchange-terms pressure lives in the coin sphere as argument classes — which coin classes both sides accept, wear and clipping disputes, and competitive claims of standing expressed through coin display, gift, and refusal — which are tendencies, never occurred incidents.
The outlet settlement, primarily imperial-remnant in culture, tends to treat the coin sphere as native ground; the hillfort tends to treat it as an instrument for dealing outward.

Each of the three cultures holds a distinct live relationship to the same thinning coin stock: original-culture households tend to keep their dealings in the internal sphere — stores, stock, and standing obligation — and to use coin as a boundary tool for strangers; imperial-remnant tradition tends to treat coin as a bearer of record and standing, though never unanimously; and in the hillfort's hybrid braid fluency in both spheres is itself a braid skill, with households straddling strands often brokering conversions; each is a tendency with internal variation and no unanimity, concerning money objects and exchange media only.

Salvage coin from remnant ground consists of dispersed single or small finds within WLD-LOCATION-004's salvage activity class — finite, diminishing, contestable, with no right, ownership, law, market, or price — and salvage coin entering the external sphere carries contestable provenance that fuels good-coin arguments without settling any.

Whether the outlet settlement's metal capability ever supports coin testing, re-melting, or new striking is an explicit open question; no mint, assay, or validation institution exists anywhere in the region.
Coin worth is social belief and custom: the System recognises no currency, attests no value, and no readout, Skill, appraisal, or office guarantees a coin's or metal's worth.
boundaries: This record is a forward culture extension filling declared-open exchange-and-value space; it alters no accepted geography, ecology, location, history, event, or culture record, and every open boundary of every record it touches stays open except the single declared closure stated here.

Sphere, prestige, coin class, worth class, tally, obligation, hoard, conversion, hillfort, and every other label are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, denomination, legend, metal, unit, price, rate, institution, office, law, script, or performance guarantee.
No price, denomination, exchange rate, quantity, unit, measurement, date, calendar, market institution, assay, toll, tariff, treaty, envoy, or trade-good list is established anywhere in this record.
No coin name, legend content, design, or specific metal is established; metal and material classes stay qualitative, and no Earth material, species, or crop is named.

Declared bounded closure of part of WLD-LOCATION-005's open economy-and-institution space and its open-other-communities boundary: no community in the region currently mints coin or holds treasury authority; everything else those openings hold — that settlement's size, population, growth history, government, leadership, institutions, law, defences, and internal economy, and the existence and condition of other communities — stays open.

WLD-LOCATION-005 remains the sole authority for the outlet settlement, and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture for its cultural texture under that record's declared closure; the coin-sphere tendency stated here lands in WLD-LOCATION-005's declared-open economy space, which WLD-CULTURE-004 expressly left open when it ceded exchange media to this record, and that closure is neither reopened nor extended; its water-power and workable-metal capability is used only as already-accepted qualitative capability, no ore, metal type, mine, working method, smelting practice, fuel, output, or works detail is established, and its internal money customs beyond the stated qualitative coin-sphere tendency remain undeveloped.

WLD-CULTURE-002's compact-finance space stays open: coin is the customary medium only where a consented communal burden is discharged in movable worth at all, no levy, assessment, rate, tax, tribute, treasury, fund, office, or compact term is established, how communal burdens are actually assessed, discharged, and recorded remains that record's open question, nothing here creates a worth-testimony office or expertise class, and whether worth knowledge ever enters WLD-CULTURE-002's sworn-testimony channel remains that record's open question.

WLD-EVENT-001 remains the sole authority for the standing rivalry; its contested exchange terms gain a monetary register as tendencies only, no occurred exchange, negotiation, embargo, interruption, dispute, insult, response, or incident is established, no market, currency standard, price, treaty, tariff, official, or delegation is created between the settlements, and no trajectory of basin control is made occurred or inevitable.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006's harvest-institution boundary stands untouched: no harvest good, harvest trade, preservation method, shore institution, ownership, rate, or law is priced, exchanged, or organised, no harvest share is a money object, and whether any harvest share ever touches either sphere remains open.

WLD-LOCATION-004 continues to govern salvage: salvage coin is an ordinary instance of its dispersed, finite, diminishing, contestable salvage activity class creating no right, ownership, law, market, price, technique, party, season, or yield; that record's no-cache default stands, so no coin hoard or cache exists on remnant ground by implication and whether any intact hoard survives there is an explicit open question; recognition of a coin as the withdrawn power's work is cultural recognition, not accurate knowledge, and no remnant functions as designed.

WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole authority for the collapse arc; coin survival is a bounded forward extension of its open surviving-fragment space adding no date, mint site, garrison, office, withdrawal detail, or collapse-cause weighting; the no-mint, no-treasury negative concerns present institutions only and leaves that record's open space for every other remaining individual, successor community, reused work, partial tradition, and expertise pocket untouched; and communities may misremember where their coin came from while folk accounts of where the stock goes are belief, not fact.

The Author-directed founding frame — a native founder of the original culture, imperial refugees admitted into the fold, unity and respect under his leadership, hybridisation only now beginning, and the original culture as the hillfort's host culture — is established by canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend alone; this record only keeps its coin-facing tendencies consistent with that frame and establishes no founding, admission, leadership, host, or settlement-relations fact of its own.

The three coin-facing tendencies concern attitudes toward money objects and exchange media only; where each culture locates worth at large, and every other culture-frame matter, belongs to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/original-kin-hall-season-court-culture and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture, each tendency carries internal variation, none is unanimity, and WLD-CULTURE-001's strands are not flattened, sorted, or reassigned.

No rite, threshold, or ceremony acquires a fee, payment, gift class, dowry, compensation, or exchange content; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/lifecycle-threshold-witness-rites remains free to use or ignore money objects, how rites, dowries, or compensation customs interface with either sphere remains open, and no faith content, rite meaning, or afterlife idea is established here.

Whatever marks a coin may carry are recognised only by familiarity; no script, legend content, legend readability, letterform, literacy claim, vocabulary, phonology, or word for money or worth is established, canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/generational-language-landscape owns the language landscape, and all in-world names and linguistic logic remain protected unknowns.

Coin worth is social belief and custom over unchanged natural System behaviour: the System recognises no currency and attests no value, no readout, Skill, appraisal, or office guarantees or reveals a coin's or metal's worth (CAL0 UI1.2D), no institution gains System-executed monetary power (CAL0 SOC1.2D), and no new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or CAL0 change is created.
The series contract's WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint and is untouched; this record adopts no project default and mentions no exceptional individual of any kind.

Sphere membership and social marking are author-side cultural truth; a character knows another household's obligations, another settlement's coin judgments, or the state of the coin stock only through an available source, and no character surveys either sphere.

A thinning trusted coin stock, contestable salvage provenance, and socially marked conversion are standing frictions at story start that the succession and the rivalry can stress; they are pressures, not occurred events, and no plot event, protagonist fact, character fact, hoard discovery, or trade incident is established.

The parked sapient pack species remains parked and gains no development, and returning peoples and other neighbors gain none either; whether any recognise, want, or refuse imperial coin remains open through WLD-HISTORY-001's neighbor channels, with no contact fact established.

WLD-LOCATION-002's travel bands and WLD-LOCATION-003's shore-endpoint arrangement are neither divided, extended, shortened, recalculated, nor given any road, shore, or landing institution; WLD-ECOLOGY-005's provenance discipline continues to bind, every object referenced is local or provenance-bounded, no import, product, or traveller-carried organism is established, and WLD-GEOGRAPHY-001's scaffold is untouched.
story_implications: Later scenes may use two-sphere dealing, socially marked conversion, coin-acceptance argument, tally and witnessed-debt credit, and dispersed salvage coin as standing texture, but every actual bargain, debt, dispute, find, refusal, and outcome requires its own evidence.

A thinning trusted coin stock, contestable salvage provenance, and socially marked conversion are standing frictions the approaching succession and the cross-lake rivalry can stress, not occurred events.
The cross-lake rivalry gains a monetary register for argument and posture without any occurred exchange, negotiation, embargo, or incident becoming canon.

Sphere fluency is character-differentiating texture, but a character knows another household's obligations, another settlement's coin judgments, or the state of the stock only through an available source.
system_implications: The selected pattern is an ordinary setting extension; money is cultural custom over unchanged natural System behaviour, and the System recognises no currency and attests no value.
No readout, Skill, appraisal, or office guarantees or reveals a coin's or metal's worth (CAL0 UI1.2D), and no institution gains System-executed monetary power (CAL0 SOC1.2D).
No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created, and the series contract's WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is untouched.

The compact's actual finances: how communal burdens are assessed, discharged, and recorded (WLD-CULTURE-002's open space).
Harvest-good exchange of every kind, and whether any harvest share ever touches either sphere (WLD-ECOLOGY-006's boundary stands).
Coin legends, scripts, readability, and all words for money and worth (the language landscape record, then protected unknowns).

Which households hoard, which salvage grounds still yield dispersed coin finds, whether any intact hoard survives on remnant ground under WLD-LOCATION-004's no-cache default, and the accuracy of folk beliefs about the shrinking stock.
The outlet settlement's internal money customs beyond its qualitative coin-sphere tendency, its internal life remaining undeveloped.
Whether returning peoples or other neighbors recognise, want, or refuse imperial coin, through neighbor channels only and with no contact fact.
How rites, dowries, or compensation customs interface with either sphere, if at all.
